supported_parent_evidence.result: 10/10 PASS deterministic unique DONE-set fold under intact bounded source

observed_candidate_read_shape: TerminalRewardReceiptFoldCandidate first opens V17 and scans effect_done_receipts_v17 into a Python list, then closes that connection.
Each source effect is subsequently re-adjudicated through TerminalRewardBridgeCandidate, which opens another V17 runtime/connection.
The receipt binds source-universe count/digest and canonical order but no authoritative transaction/checkpoint/frontier identity.
gap: The bounded fold proves duplicate/retry/cache-crash idempotence for an intact source, but it does not prove that the projected DONE universe is a complete snapshot of one authoritative source frontier under concurrent terminal commits. A new DONE can become durable after the initial scan while the fold is still verifying earlier rows. The result may be a valid prefix projection without an identity proving which authoritative frontier it covers.
risk: a consumer may treat a valid but stale prefix projection as current reward state
cache invalidation cannot distinguish exact-current from prefix-current without a source frontier
cross-process concurrent terminal commits are not covered by the existing exactly-once gate
recovery/replay cannot prove projection completeness from count/digest alone unless the source frontier is independently bound

required_successor_contract.source_read: one stable authoritative read transaction/snapshot or an independently admitted immutable terminal-event frontier
must_bind: selected semantic checkpoint/lineage identity or equivalent authoritative source identity
required_successor_contract.currentness_rule: projection may be CURRENT only when its bound source frontier equals the currently admitted authoritative frontier; otherwise it is STALE/PREFIX and may remain evidence-only
required_successor_contract.cache_rule: incremental/materialized reward cache is discardable derived state and must never advance its source frontier by assertion

required_discriminator.name: REWARD_FOLD_CONCURRENT_DONE_FRONTIER
arms: new DONE committed before snapshot acquisition
new DONE committed after snapshot/frontier capture but during fold
new DONE committed after fold completion
restart/rebuild at the exact captured frontier
stale cache presented against a newer authoritative frontier
required_discriminator.acceptance: every projection states and verifies the exact authoritative source frontier it covers; concurrent additions are either included in that frontier or cause explicit STALE/PREFIX classification, never silent currentness

strongest_counterhypothesis: If reward projection is only consumed at already-frozen semantic checkpoints and no terminal writer can coexist with a fold, a separate frontier mechanism may be redundant. That simpler topology must be machine-checked and enforced rather than assumed.
